223→            currentVolume = maxOf(currentVolume - fadeSpeed, targetVolume)
224→        }
225→
226→        if (currentVolume <= 0.01f) return
227→
228→        val categoryConfig = getCategoryConfig(currentCategory!!)
229→        val tempo = categoryConfig?.tempo ?: 100
230→        val intensity = categoryConfig?.intensity ?: 0.5f
231→        val beatInterval = 60000L / tempo
232→
233→        if (now - lastNoteTime >= beatInterval * ticksUntilNextNote) {
234→            playNote(currentCategory!!, intensity)
235→            lastNoteTime = now
236→
237→            val section = currentCategory!!.sections[currentSectionIndex]
238→            val rhythm = currentCategory!!.rhythmPatterns[currentSectionIndex % currentCategory!!.rhythmPatterns.size]
239→            rhythmIndex = (rhythmIndex + 1) % rhythm.size
240→            ticksUntilNextNote = rhythm[rhythmIndex]
241→
242→            phrasePosition = (phrasePosition + 1) % phraseLength
243→            melodyIndex = (melodyIndex + 1) % section.baseNotes.size
244→            sectionChangeCounter++
245→
246→            if (sectionChangeCounter >= sectionChangeThreshold) {
247→                sectionChangeCounter = 0
248→                currentSectionIndex = (currentSectionIndex + 1) % currentCategory!!.sections.size
249→                currentRhythmPatternIndex = (currentRhythmPatternIndex + 1) % currentCategory!!.rhythmPatterns.size
250→                melodyIndex = 0
251→                harmonyIndex = 0
252→                phrasePosition = 0
253→                bassNoteIndex = 0
254→                variationSeed = System.currentTimeMillis()
255→                StarredHeltix.LOGGER.info("[MusicEngine] Смена секции: $currentSectionIndex для ${currentCategory!!.displayName}")
256→            }
257→        }
258→    }

260→    private fun playNote(category: LocationMusicCategory, intensity: Float) {
261→        val player = mc.player ?: return
262→        val section = category.sections[currentSectionIndex]
263→        val baseNotes = section.baseNotes
264→        val harmonyNotes = section.harmonyNotes
265→
266→        // Мелодия - умный выбор ноты
267→        var noteIndex = melodyIndex % baseNotes.size
268→        if (noteIndex == lastNoteIndex) {
269→            val offset = if (random.nextBoolean()) 1 else -1
270→            noteIndex = ((noteIndex + offset) % baseNotes.size + baseNotes.size) % baseNotes.size
271→        }
272→        if (lastTwoNotes.size >= 2 &&
273→            baseNotes[noteIndex] == lastTwoNotes[0] &&
274→            baseNotes[noteIndex] == lastTwoNotes[1]) {
275→            noteIndex = (noteIndex + 2) % baseNotes.size
276→        }
277→        lastNoteIndex = noteIndex
278→        lastTwoNotes = listOf(baseNotes[noteIndex]) + lastTwoNotes.take(1)
279→
280→        val midiNote = baseNotes[noteIndex]
281→        val pitch = midiToPitch(midiNote)
282→        val volumeVariation = 0.75f + random.nextFloat() * 0.25f
283→        val volume = currentVolume * intensity * volumeVariation
284→
285→        // Случайные паузы убраны для динамичности
286→
287→        if (volume > 0.01f) {
288→            val instrument = selectInstrument(category, phrasePosition)
289→            val sound = instrument.sound
290→
291→            mc.soundManager.play(
292→                SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(sound, volume, pitch)
293→            )
294→
295→            // Бас - КАЖДУЮ долю, быстрый паттерн
296→            val bassPattern = bassPatterns[category.atmosphere] ?: listOf(36, 36, 39, 36, 41, 41, 39, 36)
297→            val bassMidi = bassPattern[bassNoteIndex % bassPattern.size]
298→            val bassPitch = midiToPitch(bassMidi)
299→            val bassVolMultiplier = if (phrasePosition % 4 == 0) 0.6f else 0.4f
300→            val bassVolume = currentVolume * bassVolMultiplier * intensity
301→
302→            mc.soundManager.play(
303→                SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_BASS.value(), bassVolume, bassPitch)
304→            )
305→            bassNoteIndex++
306→
307→            // Ударные - КАЖДУЮ долю для драйва
308→            val drumSound = when (category.atmosphere) {
309→                AtmosphereType.INTENSE -> if (phrasePosition % 2 == 0) SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_BASEDRUM.value() else SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_SNARE.value()
310→                AtmosphereType.DEEP -> SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_BASEDRUM.value()
311→                else -> SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_HAT.value()
312→            }
313→            mc.soundManager.play(
314→                SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(drumSound, currentVolume * 0.3f * intensity, 1.0f)
315→            )
316→
317→            // Хай-хэт на каждую долю для грува
318→            mc.soundManager.play(
319→                SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(SoundEvents.NOTE_BLOCK_HAT.value(), currentVolume * 0.15f * intensity, 1.1f + random.nextFloat() * 0.2f)
320→            )
321→
322→            // Гармония - КАЖДУЮ долю
323→            val harmIndex = harmonyIndex % harmonyNotes.size
324→            val harmNote = harmonyNotes[harmIndex]
325→            val harmPitch = midiToPitch(harmNote)
326→            harmonyIndex = (harmonyIndex + 1) % harmonyNotes.size
327→
328→            val harmVolume = volume * 0.35f * (0.7f + random.nextFloat() * 0.3f)
329→            mc.soundManager.play(
330→                SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(sound, harmVolume, harmPitch)
331→            )
332→
333→            // Аккорд - каждые 4 доли
334→            if (phrasePosition % 4 == 0) {
335→                val chordIndex = (harmonyIndex + 3) % harmonyNotes.size
336→                val chordNote = harmonyNotes[chordIndex]
337→                val chordPitch = midiToPitch(chordNote)
338→                val chordVolume = volume * 0.3f
339→
340→                mc.soundManager.play(
341→                    SimpleSoundInstance.forUI(sound, chordVolume, chordPitch)
342→                )
343→            }
344→        }
345→    }
